title: Siluva Prayanam – Jessi Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: అందరి రక్షణ కోరే అన్యాయపు తీర్పు పొంది
english: Nee korake naa korake Yesu siluva maranam
Andhari rakshana kori anyaayapu theerpu pondhenu
translation: The journey of the cross that took place at Calvary,
Was the sacrifice of love by the Merciful One.
For your sake and for mine, was Jesus’ death on the cross.
Though a disciple sold You and a soldier spat on You,
You were handed over and endured great humiliation.
Seeking the salvation of all, You received an unjust judgement,
And by doing so, You bound the adversary.
While the people pricked You like needles and tested the Holy One,
And even a follower claimed he did not know who Jesus was;
To mend the sheep that had fallen and gone astray,
intro: Siluva Prayanam is the latest Telugu Christian Good Friday song written by John Sandeep, sung by Jessi and music composed by P. Charan, produced by Asaph. This song was released on March 22, 2026, through BETHESDA BETHEL MINISTRIES YouTube Channel.
